source_class: user physical measurement with caliper on final DSI506/DYL0023 display assembly
interpretation_policy: The three values are preserved exactly according to the measurement definitions requested during M1-MECH-B1.
No XY location is assigned to the maximum 10 mm rear protrusion from these scalar measurements alone.

The 10 mm maximum rear envelope is the minimum hard geometric no-collision depth behind the front plane before adding assembly tolerance, FFC bend clearance, mainboard clearance or enclosure tolerance.
Do not place the M1 mainboard at Z=10 mm merely from this evidence; the DSI FFC insertion/bend envelope and local obstruction map remain open.
closed_by_this_evidence: scalar front-to-rear controller PCB Z datum
scalar nominal display assembly thickness excluding DSI cable
still_required: XY location and footprint of the maximum rear protrusions / local obstruction map
DSI FFC connector absolute XY/Z datum and insertion direction
actual FFC conductor-side / host-to-module pin-1 continuity check
FFC approach, bend radius and mating keepout
new enclosure depth and mainboard Z/standoff selection
